= Inline Formatting

== Basic Formatting

This has *bold text* and _italic text_ and `monospace text`.

This has **char-level bold** and __char-level italic__ and ``char-level monospace``.

== Combined Formatting

This has *_bold italic_* text and *`bold monospace`* text.

== Links and URLs

Visit https://example.com for more info.

Here is a link:https://example.com[labeled link].

Here is a mailto:user@example.com[email link].

== Escaping

Use \*asterisks\* without bold.

A backslash before \_underscores\_ prevents italic.

== Superscript and Subscript

H~2~O is water.

E=mc^2^ is famous.

== Line Break

This has a hard +
line break.
